text:
Riley Park: Need a lean launch quick-pack for the benchmark webinar — aim is lightweight assets for socials, email, and a one-page "cheat-sheet" cardset (3 cards, 800x420 each) and a Sankey-style flow diagram (web SVG + 600x360 PNG) that maps webinar -> lead qual -> demo -> trial and routes to Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Accessibility and brand-compliance required. Deadline: next Wed 5pm PT.

Noor Khan: Copywise I can do short hooks + three CTAs. Tone: practical & slightly urgent. Will post by tomorrow AM.

Owen Li: Quick Qs: 1) Motion for hero? Lottie allowed? 2) Dark-mode variants needed? 3) Do the Sankey arrows need metrics (ms / $/1k tokens)?

Riley Park: 1) Lottie for web only, provide GIF fallback for email. 2) Yes dark-mode exports. 3) Include optional stat labels as a toggle group in SVG so sales can toggle on/off.

Brand Review: Use palette-v3 tokens. Headline = Inter Display Bold, body = Inter Regular. No unapproved accent colors. Contrast: body >= 4.5:1. Provide alt text for every asset and short accessible captions for animations.

Noor Khan: Hooks coming: "Benchmark the true cost of latency" and "Make inference predictable at scale." CTAs: "Register", "View benchmark", "Get a demo". I'll include alt text strings with each asset.

Owen Li: I'll produce Figma comps with componentized cheat cards and a modular Sankey (separate nodes for Hosted/Dedicated/Private). Exports: SVG, PNG @2x, PDF for decks, Lottie JSON + GIF. File naming: [asset]-[channel]-[size]-v1.

DesignOps Bot: Design slot booked for Owen Tue 11am PT. If you need a rush, request override. I'll post an export checklist one day before handoff.

Riley Park: Please annotate any accessibility tradeoffs (motion, color overlays) in Figma comments. Also add a tiny alt-text doc in the file.

Owen Li: Will do. ETA first pass Tue 4pm PT. Figma link when ready: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/quickpack-sankey

Brand Review: We'll run a 24h sweep after Figma link. If anything fails contrast or font rules, we'll flag inline.

Riley Park: Great — locking deadline Wed 5pm PT. Thanks team! :rocket:
